summary: Verified fix for the production 'Failed to fetch character' full-screen block. Backend: 19 existing pytest tests still pass + 1 new test (test_seed_empty_db.py) confirms POST /api/_diag/seed now succeeds on an empty DB (previously threw ValidationError because Lore was missing backstory/currentGoal). Frontend: end-to-end scenario tested — wiped characters collection, reloaded /home: sidenav, auth-pill-login, and admin gear all render normally (no more blocking error page), SeedBanner (data-testid=seed-banner) appears at top-center, shows Sign-in button for unauthed users, opens AdminLoginModal on click, after admin login the banner swaps to Seed button (seed-banner-run), clicking Seed POSTs /api/_diag/seed with Bearer token, banner disappears via reload(), character content populates on /home without a hard page refresh. Regression: /home /dashboard /design /gallery all load 200 with character present, no red error, no console errors related to character fetch.

issues: Clicking seed-banner-signin opens AdminLoginModal which defaults to Google OAuth. Users must click the 'Use legacy admin password instead →' link to reveal the password input. Not a bug (matches AdminLoginModal design), but worth noting: on a fresh production DB with no Google admin whitelisted yet, this could be confusing. Consider making the legacy password path default when opened from SeedBanner, or add a hint.

action_items: (Optional/UX) When SeedBanner opens AdminLoginModal, consider showing the legacy password path first (or auto-focusing it) since Google whitelist may not yet be populated on a fresh production DB.
critical_code_review_comments: SeedBanner uses relative fetch('/api/_diag/seed') instead of REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Works in preview (same origin proxy) but every other component uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — inconsistent and could break if backend host differs from frontend host in prod.
MainLayout still imports `error` from useCharacter but never uses it (line 31). Dead variable — remove to keep the file clean.
CharacterContext.reload() correctly resets error state and re-fetches — good. But there's no debouncing; rapid double-click on Seed could fire two POSTs. Minor.

SeedBanner destructures `token` from useAuth() then puts it directly into Authorization header — if token is null (edge case: isAuthed briefly true while token clears) the request will send 'Bearer null'. Add a guard `if (!token) return;` before fetch.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the empty-DB seed recovery flow + character-present regression across 4 routes

test_credentials: Debut/Admin password: 'veri2024' → POST /api/auth/verify-debut → JWT (24h). Frontend: click 'Use legacy admin password instead →' inside AdminLoginModal to reveal password input (data-testid=admin-password-input).
seed_data_creation: Wiped and re-seeded characters collection during test. Final state verified: 1 character (name=Veri, lore.backstory + lore.currentGoal populated). Social_links (8) and design_elements (13) unchanged (seed is additive-safe). DB left in healthy state — preview is not broken.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All review-request criteria verified. Key testids: seed-banner, seed-banner-signin, seed-banner-run, admin-password-input, admin-login-submit, auth-pill-login, auth-pill-logout. To reveal legacy password path inside AdminLoginModal use selector text=/legacy admin password/i then click. To reproduce empty-DB state: mongosh --quiet test_database --eval 'db.characters.deleteMany({})' — remember to seed back afterwards via POST /api/_diag/seed with admin bearer.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug had two root causes both now fixed: (1) MainLayout.jsx had `if (error) return <full-screen error>` that blocked the entire UI including sidenav and sign-in pill — removed, replaced with non-blocking SeedBanner. (2) /api/_diag/seed instantiated Lore(origin=..., abilities=..., story=...) but the Lore model requires backstory + currentGoal — server.py now passes backstory + currentGoal correctly. Verified: seed on empty DB returns 200 with actions ['character: created', 'design_elements: N already exist, skipped', 'social_links: N already exist, skipped'], and GET /api/character afterwards returns full Veri profile with lore.backstory and lore.currentGoal set.
